data_description.dataset_name: Global large flood events - Dartmouth Flood Observatory (1985-2016)

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global point-event catalog of large flood events from 1985 to 2016 identified by the Dartmouth Flood Observatory.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Flood event records spanning 1985-2016; individual features carry event-level date fields.
data_description.temporal_unit: Per-event timestamp fields in feature attributes
data_description.data_type_numeric: Attribute schema is mixed; inspect property fields before numeric aggregation

property_semantics_hint.BEGAN: Start date of the flood event.
property_semantics_hint.ENDED: End date of the flood event.
property_semantics_hint.DURATION: Duration of the flood event in days.
property_semantics_hint.MAINCAUSE: Original main cause classification of the flood.
property_semantics_hint.MAINCAUSEF: Simplified main cause classification for mapping purposes.
property_semantics_hint.SEVERITY: Severity rating of the flood event.

data_description.important_note: Description fields below were populated from the Dartmouth Flood Observatory catalog. The dataset includes flood type, cause, severity, and impact metrics. Some event types have been merged under MAINCAUSEF for mapping purposes.
analytical_capabilities: Flood event clustering and spatial analysis
Seasonal and long-term flood trend analysis

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Event-level categorical attributes plus count fields such as DEAD and DISPLACED.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use event date fields, severity descriptors, and impact count fields directly from the feature table; inspect MAINCAUSE for detailed classification.

data_description.data_source: Dartmouth Flood Observatory via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
